description_en: Retrieves the DLF roles assigned to a specific user
description_zh: 获取单个User的数据湖角色列表
name: ListUserRoles

parameters.help_en:
Uniquely identifies a RAM user or RAM role. The format is:

- RAM user: acs:ram::\[accountId]:user/\[userName].

- RAM role: acs:ram::\[accountId]:role/\[roleName]
parameters.help_zh:
用于唯一标识RAM用户或RAM角色。格式为：

- RAM用户：acs:ram::[accountId]:user/[userName]。

- RAM角色：acs:ram::[accountId]:role/[roleName]
parameters.name: principal_arn

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A regular expression that matches the role name. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 角色名称匹配的正则表达式，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: role_name_pattern

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If the response does not return this token, pass an empty string ("")
parameters.help_zh: 翻页令牌，用于获取下一页数据。如果响应结果中没有提供，则传空字符串（""）或空字符（''）
parameters.name: next_page_token
